reason: Independently reproduced on Go 1.26.6 woven builds: wrapping slice or concat expressions inside len/cap/range array operands makes Go evaluate operands the spec leaves unevaluated. Result: runtime panics (4 shapes, including array-pointer conversion and range) and compile errors in const and array-length contexts. unsafe.Sizeof control unaffected. Rule-1 violation independent of the IAST gate. Downgraded one step because every trigger is an uncommon construct. The Go 1.27.0 check was blocked by an unrelated encoding/json weaving failure.
repro_command: GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 GOFLAGS=-p=4 go tool orchestrion go test -timeout 10m -count=1 -v ./fxunevaluated ./fxconstctx  # files from .omo/review/evidence/fx-hooks-orchestrion-dep-F1/ placed in fxunevaluated/ and fxconstctx/ at the module root
